name: crypto-exchange-licence-status
title: Crypto exchange licence status by country (ExchangeCatalogue)
description: Which of 27 crypto exchanges may serve people in 32 countries (the EU 27, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, the UK and India), with the company, regulator, licence ID or LEI, date checked and source. From official registers. CC BY 4.0.

resources.name: ec-crypto-licence-status-v1-2026-09-29
resources.description: One row per exchange per country.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter code (GB for the UK, GR for Greece).

fields.name: status
fields.description: licensed, passported, registered, not_passported, restricted_by_exchange, warning, blocked, not_on_register or unclear. See the list above.

fields.name: legal_entity
fields.description: The company that holds the licence or registration. For EU rows, the EU company you would deal with.

fields.name: regulator
fields.description: The regulator that granted it, with its country.

fields.name: licence_id
fields.description: The LEI (EU) or the FCA firm reference number (UK), when there is one.

fields.name: licence_id_type
fields.description: LEI or FRN. Empty when there is no ID.

fields.name: home_country
fields.description: For MiCA licences, the EU or EEA country that granted the licence.

fields.name: mica_services
fields.description: MiCA service codes from the ESMA register, a to j (see below).

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Date the licence or registration took effect (YYYY-MM-DD).
